# PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS] This practice direction supplements CPR Part 55

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS] CONTENTS OF THIS PRACTICE DIRECTION

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS] Title | Paragraph No.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS] General – introductory and interpretation | Paragraph 1.1

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS] No listing, relisting or referral in stayed claims without Paragraph 2.1 reactivation notice | Paragraph 2.1

## General – introductory and interpretation

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > General – introductory and interpretation] 1.1 This practice direction is made under rule 55.A1 and provides for temporary modification of Part 55 during the period beginning with 20 September 2020 (the end of the stay imposed by rule 55.29) and ending (subject to paragraphs 1.8 and 1.9) on 30 November 2021 (“the interim period”).

## 1.2 During the interim period, Part 55 has effect subject to this practice direction.

## 1.3 In this practice direction—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 1.3 In this practice direction—] “stayed claim” means a claim which was brought on or before 19 September 2020 (including an appeal from a decision in such a claim) and which is accordingly subject to the stay imposed by rule 55.29;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 1.3 In this practice direction—] “new claim” means a claim brought after 19 September 2020.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 1.3 In this practice direction—] 1.4 Paragraphs 2.1 to 3.1 and 5.1 to 5.4 of this practice direction apply only to stayed claims (and attention is drawn to paragraph 2.2, which provides that paragraph 2.1 – and therefore the requirement for a reactivation notice – does not apply to stayed claims brought on or after 3 August 2020 or stayed claims in which a final possession order has been made).

## 1.5 Paragraph 4.1 of this practice direction applies to all claims whenever brought.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 1.5 Paragraph 4.1 of this practice direction applies to all claims whenever brought.] 1.6 Paragraph 6.1 of this practice direction applies to all claims, including stayed claims, brought on or after 3 August 2020.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 1.5 Paragraph 4.1 of this practice direction applies to all claims whenever brought.] 1.7 Paragraph 6.2 of this practice direction applies only to new claims to which Section II of Part 55 applies.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 1.5 Paragraph 4.1 of this practice direction applies to all claims whenever brought.] 1.8 This practice direction continues to have effect after 30 November 2021 in relation to claims issued before 1 December 2021.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 1.5 Paragraph 4.1 of this practice direction applies to all claims whenever brought.] 1.9 Paragraphs 6.1 and 6.2 of this practice direction continue to have effect until 30 June 2022 in relation to any claim issued on or after 3 August 2020, including any claim issued after 30 November 2021.

## No listing, relisting, hearing or referral in stayed claims without reactivation notice

## 2.1 Subject to paragraph 2.2, and unless the court directs otherwise, no stayed claim is to be—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.1 Subject to paragraph 2.2, and unless the court directs otherwise, no stayed claim is to be—] (a) listed;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.1 Subject to paragraph 2.2, and unless the court directs otherwise, no stayed claim is to be—] (b) relisted;

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.1 Subject to paragraph 2.2, and unless the court directs otherwise, no stayed claim is to be—] (c) heard; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.1 Subject to paragraph 2.2, and unless the court directs otherwise, no stayed claim is to be—] (d) referred to a judge under rule 55.15,

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.1 Subject to paragraph 2.2, and unless the court directs otherwise, no stayed claim is to be—] until one of the parties files and serves a written notice (a “reactivation notice”) confirming that they wish the case to be listed, relisted, heard or referred.

## 2.2 Paragraph 2.1 does not apply to a stayed claim—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.2 Paragraph 2.1 does not apply to a stayed claim—] (a) which was brought on or after 3 August 2020; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.2 Paragraph 2.1 does not apply to a stayed claim—] (b) in which a final order for possession has been made.

## 2.3 A reactivation notice must—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.3 A reactivation notice must—] (a) confirm that the party filing and serving it wishes the case to be listed, relisted, heard or referred; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.3 A reactivation notice must—] (b) except in proceedings relating to an appeal, set out what knowledge that party has as to the effect of the Coronavirus pandemic on the Defendant and their dependants.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.3 A reactivation notice must—] 2.4 Except in proceedings relating to an appeal, where a reactivation notice is filed and served by the Claimant and the claim is based on arrears of rent, the Claimant must provide with the notice an updated rent account for the previous two years.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.3 A reactivation notice must—] 2.5 Unless the court orders otherwise, any trial date set prior to 27 March 2020 (the date on which Practice Direction 51Z came into force) shall be vacated and the case stayed unless a party complies with the provisions of paragraphs 2.1, 2.3, 2.4 and 5.1 not less than 42 days prior to the hearing date.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.3 A reactivation notice must—] 2.6 If by 4.00 p.m. on 30 April 2021 no reactivation notice has been filed and served in relation to a stayed claim to which paragraph 2.1 applies, that claim will be automatically stayed.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 2.3 A reactivation notice must—] 2.7 A stay under paragraph 2.5 or 2.6 is not a sanction for breach; and an application to lift the stay is accordingly not an application for relief from sanctions under rule 3.9.

## Notice of listed or relisted hearings in stayed claims

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Notice of listed or relisted hearings in stayed claims] 3.1 The court must, unless it directs otherwise, give at least 21 days’ notice to the parties of any hearing listed or relisted in response to a reactivation notice.

## All claims where no hearing listed

## 4.1 During the interim period, rule 55.5 applies with the following modifications—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 4.1 During the interim period, rule 55.5 applies with the following modifications—] (a) paragraph (1) is modified to read—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 4.1 During the interim period, rule 55.5 applies with the following modifications—] “(1) Subject to paragraph (1A), the court will fix a date for the hearing when or after it issues the claim form.”; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > 4.1 During the interim period, rule 55.5 applies with the following modifications—] (b) paragraph (3)(b) (standard period between issue and hearing of eight weeks) does not apply.

## Stayed claims where case management directions made

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] 5.1 In relation to a stayed claim to which paragraph 2.1 applies and in which case management directions were made before 20 September 2020, a party filing and serving a reactivation notice must file and serve with it—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] (a) a copy of the last directions order together with new dates for compliance with the directions taking account of the stay before 20 September 2020; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] (b) either—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] (i) a draft order setting out additional or alternative directions (including proposing a new hearing date) which are required; or

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] (ii) a statement in writing that no new directions are required and that an existing hearing date can be met; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] (c) a statement in writing whether the case is suitable for hearing by video or audio link.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] 5.2 If the other parties do not agree with any of the matters advanced under paragraph 5.1(a), (b) and (c), they must file and serve a response within 14 days of service of the reactivation notice.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] 5.3 If no party has complied with paragraph 5.1 by 4.00 p.m. on 30 April 2021, the claim will be automatically stayed.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] 5.4 A stay under paragraph 5.3 is not a sanction for breach; and an application to lift the stay is accordingly not an application for relief from sanctions under rule 3.9.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] 6.1 In any claim (whether a new claim or a stayed claim) brought on or after 3 August 2020, the Claimant must—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] (a) bring to the hearing two copies of a notice—

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] (i)  in a claim to which the Pre-Action Protocol for Possession Claims by Social Landlords is applicable, confirming that the Claimant has complied with that Pre-Action Protocol and detailing how the Claimant has done so; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] (ii)  in all claims, setting out what knowledge that party has as to the effect of the Coronavirus pandemic on the Defendant and their dependants; and

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] (b)  serve on the Defendant not less than 14 days prior to the hearing the notices referred to in sub-paragraph (a) setting out what knowledge that party has as to the effect of the Coronavirus pandemic on the Defendant and their dependants.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] 6.2In any claim (whether a new claim or a stayed claim) brought on or after 3 August 2020 to which Section II of Part 55 applies the Claimant must file with the claim form for service with it a notice setting out what knowledge that party has as to the effect of the Coronavirus pandemic on the Defendant and their dependants.

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] (For a claim to which the Pre-Action Protocol for Possession Claims based on Mortgage or Home Purchase Plan Arrears in Respect of Residential Property is applicable, paragraph 5.5 of Practice Direction 55A requires the Claimant to bring to the hearing two completed copies of Form N123 (the mortgage pre-action protocol checklist).)

[PRACTICE DIRECTION 55C – CORONAVIRUS: TEMPORARY PROVISION IN RELATION TO POSSESSION PROCEEDINGS > Stayed claims where case management directions made] Updated: Tuesday, 16 November 2021
